assignment.title: Writing a postmortem
assignment.instructions: Write a postmortem for the checkout outage described in the practice scenario pack.

sections.heading: Instructions
paragraphs: Submit as a PDF by Friday.

sections.heading: Criteria
paragraphs: A root cause with the evidence for it
Action items, each with an owner

submission.text:
Postmortem: the checkout outage on the practice shop

Timeline (all times local)
14:02 A configuration change lowering the database connection pool limit was deployed.
14:09 The error-rate alert fired for the checkout service.
14:15 The on-call engineer acknowledged the alert and began reading the service logs.
14:31 The pool limit was set back to its previous value.
14:40 Error rates returned to normal and the alert cleared.

Root cause
The root cause was that the connection pool limit in the new configuration was set too low for the checkout service.

Customer impact
Many customers saw error pages when they tried to pay, and some of them gave up and left their baskets. The support inbox received a lot of messages about it that evening.

Notes on how we worked
The change was reviewed and approved in the usual way, and the reviewer had no reason to expect trouble from a one-line change. The team found the problem together, and each person who looked at the logs shared what they saw as they saw it. The configuration format made it easy for the value to look reasonable, and nobody involved acted carelessly.
